concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-salesforce-commerce-cloud-composable-storefront-customization-guide]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Composable Storefront/PWA package guide for front-end, server-controller and webhook overrides, with post-deployment/testing advice, package-edit prohibition and no pre-built Salesforce OMS integration.
warnings: The raw introductory back-end path says `ovverrides/app/ssr.js` while its webhook extension path says `overrides/app/ssr.js`; verify the installed package path.
Examples and status-update instructions are not proof of a completed payment, OMS export or settlement.
